content: Project kickoff: We are designing Context Engine for LLM context management.
Architecture decision 1: Database engine is SQLite using better-sqlite3.
Architecture decision 2: Embedding model is Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 running in process.
Chatter: Weather is sunny today, setup looks straightforward.
Architecture decision 3: Proxy server default port is 4000 and web server port is 3000.
Architecture decision 4: Tokenizer uses gpt-tokenizer for OpenAI and 10% fudge factor for Claude.
Chatter: Discussion about coffee break preferences.
Architecture decision 5: MCP server registers 5 tools: recall, commit, branch, merge, checkout.
Architecture decision 6: Database table schema includes commits, chunks, branches, conflicts, summary_cache.
RECALL QUESTION 1: What database engine, embedding model, and proxy port did we select?
Feature 1: Proxy supports Anthropic POST /v1/messages and OpenAI POST /v1/chat/completions.
Feature 2: Session resolution priority is header > metadata > query > hash_fallback.
Chatter: Random note on terminal fonts and color themes.
Feature 3: CLI watch view uses Ink (React for CLIs) with StatsBar, BranchList, CommitLog.
Feature 4: Merge conflict detection uses topic_label matching and content difference checks.
Feature 5: Manual overrides via promoteChunk append a new commit with override reason_log.
Chatter: Specifying test timeouts and Vitest configurations.
Feature 6: Local LLMs like Ollama are supported via LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL env var.
Feature 7: Proxy binds to 127.0.0.1 by default for security.
RECALL QUESTION 2 & 3: What is the session resolution priority order, and how does manual override history work?
Polish 1: Shadow mode logs token savings while forwarding the original unmodified payload.
Polish 2: Web UI dashboard presents StatCards, BranchList, CommitTimeline, and ConflictAlert.
Chatter: Reviewing deployment checklists and release tags.
Polish 3: Embedding model is warmed at proxy startup to prevent first-request latency spikes.
Polish 4: Summary cache avoids re-summarizing unchanged chunks using SHA-256 hash keys.
Chatter: Discussion about repository README structure and badges.
Polish 5: Root gitignore excludes .env, context.db, node_modules, dist.
Polish 6: Evaluation script replays 30 turns and logs tokens, cost, latency, and recall answers.
Chatter: Final verification steps before release.
RECALL QUESTION 4 & 5: List the 5 MCP tools and explain how shadow mode functions.
